description: Adds variants to a burst by their values of its report parameters, or of its filters for an older report's burst: each is a copy of the template report with its own values, then runs once to fetch its data. An older report's variant is a copy of its file in the burst's folder. Report parameter values and filter ids are checked first, so a request with one the burst can't take adds nothing. Answers at once with the batch's batchId and the names the variants are added with: follow the batch with getBurstVariantBatch until it ends.

body.description: What the tool creates, changes or sends

variants.description: The variants to add, 1 to 500. Variants may hold the same values as one another or as an existing variant: each is added as its own report.

additionalProperties.description: A value of a filter, in the shape of its `valueType`, the same shapes as a report parameter value. Copy the shape of a variant's value of the filter in `listBurstVariants`.

filters.description: For a burst by `filters`: the value the variant applies to each filter, by its `id` in the burst's `filters`, at least one. A filter left out keeps its value on the dashboard. An id that isn't one of the burst's filters returns 400 and adds nothing.

name.description: The variant's name, which its report's name is built from as the burst's `variantNaming` says. If omitted, it is named after the values it sets, like `EMEA - Q1 2026`: its parameters' values, or its primary filters' values.

additionalProperties.description:
A value of a report parameter, in the shape of its type. Copy the shape of the parameter's `value` in `listBursts`, or of a variant's in `listBurstVariants`:

- A list of values: `{ "type": "categorical", "values": ["EMEA"] }`, with at least one value. `operator` can also be `is_not`, `contains` or `doesnt_contain`; it is `is` when left out.
- A number: `{ "type": "number", "value": 10 }`. Text: `{ "type": "text", "value": "EMEA" }`.
- A date range: `{ "type": "date", "subtype": "date_range", "startDate": "2026-01-01", "endDate": "2026-03-31" }`. One date: `{ "type": "date", "subtype": "date_single", "date": "2026-03-31" }`.
- A month or a quarter: `{ "type": "date", "subtype": "date_month_year", "month": 3, "year": 2026 }` (months 1 to 12), `{ "type": "date", "subtype": "date_quarter_year", "quarter": 1, "year": 2026 }`.
- A relative period: `{ "type": "date", "subtype": "date_relative", "rangeType": "lastN", "rangeN": 3, "periodType": "months" }`. `rangeType` is `current`, `lastN` or `nextN`; `periodType` is `days`, `weeks`, `months`, `quarters` or `years`, or `completeDays` through `completeYears` for whole periods only.

parameters.description: For a burst by `parameters`: the value the variant sets of each report parameter, by its `id` in the burst's `parameters`. A parameter left out keeps the template's value. A value must be one the template's datasheet filters can take, or the request returns 400 and adds nothing.

idempotencyKey.description: A unique value, such as a UUID, that makes retrying this call safe. A retry with the same key within 24 hours answers the first call's result instead of running it again. Use a new key for each new call. From 1 to 255 printable ASCII characters.

params.description: The ids of what the tool acts on

id.description: The burst to act on, by its `id` from `listBursts`. You can also copy it from the burst's link in Rollstack: it's the part right after `/collections/`.

name: addBurstVariants
title: Add burst variants
